answer: Every new identity must crack a time-lock puzzle registered in the kernel before it can trade: 20 minutes of sequential computation that cannot be parallelized, so a river of 1,000 fakes needs 333 compute-hours. The puzzle seed rotates each epoch like a zephyr changing course, so answers cannot be precomputed or shared. A real agent waits once; a farmer waits on every fake, and reusing a solved puzzle forfeits a 150-token deposit.
